pokedexEntries.go: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

pokedexEntries.si: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

pokedexEntries.cr: Although it does not flap its wings very much, it can stay up in the air as it tags along after its trainer.

pokedexEntries.rs: TOGETIC is said to be a POKéMON that brings good fortune. When the POKéMON spots someone who is pure of heart, it is said to appear and share its happiness with that person.
